test_cuad_metric: test the CUAD metric class that computes EM, F1, AUPR, and precision at recall thresholds for legal contract QA evaluation
create_cuad_compute: create a CUAD metric instance and compute exact_match, f1, aupr, prec_at_80_recall, and prec_at_90_recall scores from predictions and references
review_cuad_info: review the CUAD metric _info method that returns MetricInfo with description, citation, features schema, and reference URLs
summarize_cuad_compute: summarize the CUAD _compute method that transforms predictions and references into the official scoring format and returns evaluation scores
build_cuad_evaluate: build a CUAD evaluation pipeline using evaluate.load to score legal contract clause extraction predictions against expert-annotated references
